questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: Describe how to determine the density of an irregular stone using a displacement can, including the equipment and calculation. (4 marks)

accepted: Measure the stone's mass using a balance. Fill a displacement (Eureka) can to the spout, then lower the stone fully. Collect displaced water and measure its volume using a measuring cylinder. Calculate density as stone mass divided by displaced volume.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: Describe the method for measuring the density of a liquid using a measuring cylinder and balance. (4 marks)

accepted: Record the mass of the empty cylinder or tare the balance. Measure a known volume of liquid in the measuring cylinder. Determine the liquid mass by subtracting the empty-cylinder mass from the full-cylinder mass. Divide liquid mass by liquid volume and give matching units.
